What the site is

The site sets out an argument, from an Islamic standpoint, concerning Paul of Tarsus and his place in Christianity. Its articles are drawn from the book by Mohd Elfie Nieshaem Juferi on which the site is based, and they are offered for reading, study and discussion.

The text, illustrations and design of the site are the copyright of Mohd Elfie Nieshaem Juferi unless stated otherwise. You may quote short passages for comment, criticism, study or review, provided that you name the site and link to the page quoted. Republishing whole articles, or substantial parts of them, requires written permission.

Material by others keeps its own terms. Photographs of works of art are credited, with their licences, beneath each image. Scripture is quoted from the King James Version, which is in the public domain, and from the SBL Greek New Testament, under its licence. The notes of the late Dale B. Martin are published with his permission and may not be republished from this site.

Links to other sites

The site links to other websites for sources and further reading. Their content and their terms are their own.

No warranty

The site is provided as it stands. Every source is cited so that readers may check it, and corrections are welcome, but the publisher gives no warranty that the site will be free of error or always available, and accepts no liability for loss arising from its use.
